en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: 'Несте' is a dialect vocative of 'невесто'. 'Да ми пукнат ... твоите очи' in the first oath is my reading: the line seems to say 'may your eyes burst', and I kept it as written.

lines.en: - Hey, bride, oh, Stojanica,
why has your face darkened,
oh, like unbleached linen,
why has your face, bride, darkened,
why have your lips been scorched,
oh, like walnut shells?
- Hey, Stojan, oh, my master,
because of your wrongdoings,

lines.cyr: море, зошто одиш в' туѓа земја,
lines.lat: more, zošto odiš v' tuǵa zemja,
lines.en: oh, why do you go to a foreign land,

lines.cyr: зошто одиш, Стојан, в' туѓа земја,
lines.lat: zošto odiš, Stojan, v' tuǵa zemja,
lines.en: why do you go, Stojan, to a foreign land,
there you love another sweetheart,
oh, another sweetheart besides me.

lines.cyr: - Да се колнам, несте, не ми веруваш,
lines.lat: - Da se kolnam, neste, ne mi veruvaš,
lines.en: - If I swear, bride, you will not believe me,

lines.cyr: да се крстам, ќе ми се смееш,
lines.lat: da se krstam, ḱe mi se smeeš,
lines.en: if I cross myself, you will laugh at me,

lines.cyr: море, да се крстам, ќе ми се смееш.
lines.lat: more, da se krstam, ḱe mi se smeeš.
lines.en: oh, if I cross myself, you will laugh at me.

lines.cyr: - Да ми пукнат, несте, твоите очи,
lines.lat: - Da mi puknat, neste, tvoite oči,
lines.en: - May my eyes burst, bride, yours,
if I love another sweetheart,
oh, another sweetheart besides you.

lines.cyr: - Не колни се, Стојан, во очиве,
lines.lat: - Ne kolni se, Stojan, vo očive,
lines.en: - Do not swear by your eyes, Stojan,
my eyes are only mine,

lines.cyr: море, заколни се што е твое.
lines.lat: more, zakolni se što e tvoe.
lines.en: oh, swear by what is yours.

lines.cyr: - Да ми пукне, несте, машкото дете,
lines.lat: - Da mi pukne, neste, maškoto dete,
lines.en: - May my son burst, bride, my male child,
if I love another sweetheart,
oh, another sweetheart besides you.

lines.cyr: - Не колни се, Стојан, во детено,
lines.lat: - Ne kolni se, Stojan, vo deteno,
lines.en: - Do not swear by the child, Stojan,
the child is mine and yours,

lines.cyr: море, заколни се што е твое.
lines.lat: more, zakolni se što e tvoe.
lines.en: oh, swear by what is yours.

lines.cyr: - Да ми пукнат, несте, моиве очи,
lines.lat: - Da mi puknat, neste, moive oči,
lines.en: - May my own eyes burst, bride,
if I love another sweetheart,
oh, another sweetheart besides you.
Stojan had not even finished the word,
when both his eyes burst,
oh, because he loved another sweetheart.
